reasons.plausibility: It aligns well with established dislocation-dominated deformation mechanisms in FCC alloys across varied strain rates and temperatures, making it scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: Systematic mechanical and microstructural tests at different temperatures and strain rates can directly confirm or refute the predicted dislocation accumulation and recovery behavior.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a clear mechanistic framework and experimental design that would guide researchers in understanding and optimizing the dynamic performance of Co-free FeNiCrMn alloys.
